::: item
[How Representative Are Politically Active Social Media Users? A Descriptive Large-Scale Study of Danish Twitter Users]{.title}

[with Michael Bang Petersen and Stig Hebbelstrup Rye Rasmussen · in progress]{.meta}

[Political debate on social media is often read as a reflection of public opinion, even though the people who produce it may not resemble the population at large. Linking a large sample of Danish Twitter users to population data, this descriptive study documents how the politically active social-media public differs from ordinary citizens.]{.description}
:::

:::
